effect_description_eng:
When you would play this card from your hand, you may delete 1 of your purple [Cherubimon] to reduce this card's play cost by 8.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] For each Tamer you have in play, activate the effect below.
・1 of your opponent's Digimon gets ＜Security A. -2＞ (This Digimon checks 2 fewer security cards.) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
